definition: Held completely still by shock, fear, or intense attention.
author: Mark Twain
quote: There was a rustle in the gallery, which nobody noticed; a moment later the church door creaked; the minister raised his streaming eyes above his handkerchief, and stood transfixed!
example_sentence: The children sat transfixed by the magician.
